what_happened.line: The Capital Planning Committee reviewed the list of FY24 capital requests across facilities, fire, public works and schools; no funding decisions were made.
The committee agreed that multi-part and carried-over projects will be numbered with an appended letter, with footnotes explaining their history.
Members discussed a special purpose stabilization account for fire equipment that could reduce the capital money needed for the rescue vehicle request.
The town manager will bring the list to the Green Communities committee to seek grant funding; the next grant round is not before next fall.
The next meeting was set for October 26, with department presentations on November 7 and November 9; the only vote was to adjourn.

why_it_matters: These requests are the starting list for what the town may later ask residents to fund through the capital budget, so the scoring and any use of the fire stabilization account or grants would change how much has to be raised from taxes.
Department presentations in November are the points at which residents can ask questions about specific requests before any funding recommendation is made.
